newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens at new high, led by Dow's record.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens at new high, led by Dow's record.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of leading UK shares advanced to a new high at Thursday's opening, aided by the Dow's rally overnight to a record close, and by a continuing squeeze, dealers said.
"The market's got momentum and it's reacting to good news but not to bad," said a dealer.
"It all feels a bit unreal, with people seeing the magic 5,000 level and getting sucked in with dollar signs in their eyes," he said.
The index was 21.1 points up at 5,047.3 by 0747 GMT.
